all.src: Net credit >= 25% of width - a fly collects more than a condor and should be held to a higher bar.
Max loss per position <= 1% of equity; at most 1 concurrent 0DTE butterfly; counts against the 3%-per-day 0DTE defined-risk budget.
All four legs OI >= 1000; one MLeg limit order at the mid; no chasing beyond $0.02.

management.src: Take profit at 25% of credit - a 0DTE fly does not need to be held for the pin to pay; holding for the full credit is how the structure turns into its max loss.
Stop loss at 1.5x the credit received (tighter than the condor because the body is ATM from the start).

safety_gaps.why: the structure has 2 short leg(s) and no compiled assignment guard. These are AMERICAN options on shares: a short that finishes in the money delivers 100 shares per contract the account never sized for.
